## 想解决什么 / The problem

描述具体场景。你现在怎么做，哪里不顺？
Describe the situation, your current approach, and what gets in the way.

## 希望得到什么 / Desired result

举一个可能的输入与期望输出。
Give an example input and the result you would find useful.

## 灵感或来源 / Inspiration or sources

如有参考书、文章、工具或上游 Skill，请附来源。
Link any relevant book, article, tool, or upstream skill.
